title: Night Scarb's measurements of the Osiris shaft scan
summary: Jeffrey tells of Night Scarb's measurements of the Osiris shaft scan, about 2024 at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So this is from a channel called Night Scarb who did measurements that show that the signatures are off and that the measurements don't exactly match the known configuration.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to work by an online channel called Night Scarb about the Osiris shaft, a deep shaft beneath the ground at Giza in Egypt that was scanned around 2024. According to Jeffrey, Night Scarb's measurements show that the scan's signals are off and do not match the shaft's known layout. If so, it would suggest there is more down there than the known structure.
